cost_definitions.elapsed_seconds: Legacy alias of elapsed_seconds_this_attempt, not cumulative training cost.
cost_definitions.elapsed_seconds_this_attempt: Cell wall time through training/checkpoint restoration and PI evaluation in the attempt that produced this completed cell. Not cumulative across retries; unchanged on cell reuse.
cost_definitions.training_seconds_total: Cumulative successful training time from the final checkpoint; restored task prefixes count once. Excludes buffer selection, evaluation, checkpoint I/O, and work lost before a checkpoint, so this is not total resource consumption across failed attempts.

effective_config.data_policy: Only globally deduplicated, label-conflict-removed, mapping-bound prepared input; task order belongs to the frozen mapping
effective_config.regularization_policy: Frozen Section15 NSL calibration coefficients, unchanged from Section17; no tuning

self_margin_definition: score_c - max(score_k for k in classes seen before transition, k != c); the same old contrast set is used at both checkpoints

caveats: CredentialAttack is a broad parent: ToN password includes brute force or sniffing, not identical to CSE brute force.
WebAttack is a broad parent: attack implementations and subtype mixtures differ across domains.
Backdoor is not mapped to Infiltration; Scanning has no shared target category.
WebAttack is the final task and has no old-class drift unit.
Equality is exact in cached float32 representation, not the original decimal strings.
Hash partition approximates 80/20 per class; all holdout rows retained without balancing.
Whole-group exclusions use both domains labels before training as prespecified data hygiene, not target parameter fitting.
